title: Miraculous Feats of the Chinese Police
synopsis: Learn about forensic science techniques used in China, both ancient and modern.

fullText.simplified:
中国警察有“神功”

    中国的历史上有很多特别厉害的人物，他们凭借自己超常的分析力和独特的技能破获了无数离奇复杂的案件。比如“唐朝神探狄仁杰”，“大宋第一法医宋慈”……
    虽然古代没有现在这么高精尖的科技手段，但是却有很多有趣、神奇的检验技巧。比如宋慈的“蒸骨验伤”法。“蒸骨验伤”法的第一步是“蒸骨”，这是为了让骨骼更干净，方便检验。因为人活着的时候要是被打了，血液会渗入骨质中，骨头上会有血痕。但是，这些血痕光靠眼睛很难看见，所以，宋慈想出了第二步：撑开一把红油纸伞，用红油纸伞过滤太阳光，透过纸伞过滤太阳光，人们就能清晰地看见骨头上的这些痕迹！现代法医用紫外线检验骨伤，依然是这个原理。
    古代就有这么厉害的高手了，到了现在，中国警察们又有了哪些破案“神功”呢？
    先介绍一下“看脚印，抓凶手”，也就是“足迹检验”。通过脚印，不仅可以判断出一个人的身高、体重、体态、行走姿势等，就连性别、年龄都能从脚印中确定出来。比如，中国曾经发生过一起性质恶劣的连环杀人案，23人被害。犯罪分子每次作案的时候，穿的都是不同的鞋子。公安摸排了4000多个嫌疑对象，并将他们的鞋印和赤脚印拓印下来，但是没有人敢确认哪一双脚印同现场的足迹相吻合。但经过足迹专家对足迹的分析，得出以下结论：嫌犯38岁左右，身高168厘米，体态偏胖。警方照此追捕，在一周之内，就抓获了犯罪嫌疑人。
    还有“画像追凶”，一支笔，一张纸，根据目击者的描述，清晰准确地画出嫌疑人的样子，并且随着时间的推移，还会为画像加上时间刻度。无论过了多长时间，都让犯罪分子无所遁形。比如，甘肃兰州特大连环杀人案，让兰州市民一时间人心惶惶。画像专家通过目击者的描述，很快画出了让目击者大呼“太像了”的画像。画像贴遍全市，甚至被贴到了凶手门口。凶手看到门口与自己一模一样的画像，自知已走投无路，只能投案自首了。
    除了痕检和画像，中国法医们也从古代文献中找到了很多检验灵感，现代科技和古代经验相结合，在侦查破案过程中发挥了巨大的作用。其中宋代宋慈的《洗冤集录》就是每个法医都必看的法医学好书。
    正是由于中国警察们的不懈努力，他们既学习国外先进的刑侦技术，又汲取古代技术的经验，同时还结合中国的国情不断创新，所以近些年中国的破案率明显提高了。
fullText.traditional:
中國警察有“神功”

    中國的歷史上有很多特別厲害的人物，他們憑借自己超常的分析力和獨特的技能破獲了無數離奇複雜的案件。比如“唐朝神探狄仁傑”，“大宋第一法醫宋慈”……
    雖然古代沒有現在這麼高精尖的科技手段，但是卻有很多有趣、神奇的檢驗技巧。比如宋慈的“蒸骨驗傷”法。“蒸骨驗傷”法的第一步是“蒸骨”，這是為了讓骨骼更乾淨，方便檢驗。因為人活著的時候要是被打了，血液會滲入骨質中，骨頭上會有血痕。但是，這些血痕光靠眼睛很難看見，所以，宋慈想出了第二步：撐開一把紅油紙傘，用紅油紙傘過濾太陽光，透過紙傘過濾太陽光，人們就能清晰地看見骨頭上的這些痕跡！現代法醫用紫外線檢驗骨傷，依然是這個原理。
    古代就有這麼厲害的高手了，到了現在，中國警察們又有了哪些破案“神功”呢？
    先介紹一下“看腳印，抓兇手”，也就是“足跡檢驗”。通過腳印，不僅可以判斷出一個人的身高、體重、體態、行走姿勢等，就連性別、年齡都能從腳印中確定出來。比如，中國曾經發生過一起性質惡劣的連環殺人案，23人被害。犯罪份子每次作案的時候，穿的都是不同的鞋子。公安摸排了4000多個嫌疑對象，並將他們的鞋印和赤腳印拓印下來，但是沒有人敢確認哪一雙腳印同現場的足跡相吻合。但經過足跡專家對足跡的分析，得出以下結論：嫌犯38歲左右，身高168釐米，體態偏胖。警方照此追捕，在一週之內，就抓獲了犯罪嫌疑人。
    還有“畫像追凶”，一支筆，一張紙，根據目擊者的描述，清晰準確地畫出嫌疑人的樣子，並且隨著時間的推移，還會為畫像加上時間刻度。無論過了多長時間，都讓犯罪份子無所遁形。比如，甘肅蘭州特大連環殺人案，讓蘭州市民一時間人心惶惶。畫像專家通過目擊者的描述，很快畫出了讓目擊者大呼“太像了”的畫像。畫像貼遍全市，甚至被貼到了兇手門口。兇手看到門口與自己一模一樣的畫像，自知已走投無路，只能投案自首了。
    除了痕檢和畫像，中國法醫們也從古代文獻中找到了很多檢驗靈感，現代科技和古代經驗相結合，在偵查破案過程中發揮了巨大的作用。其中宋代宋慈的《洗冤集錄》就是每個法醫都必看的法醫學好書。
    正是由於中國警察們的不懈努力，他們既學習國外先進的刑偵技術，又汲取古代技術的經驗，同時還結合中國的國情不斷創新，所以近些年中國的破案率明顯提高了。

sentences.traditional: 畫像貼遍全市，甚至被貼到了兇手門口。
sentences.pinyin: huà xiàng tiē biàn quán shì shèn zhì bèi tiē dào le xiōng shǒu mén kǒu
sentences.english: Using witness descriptions, a forensic sketch artist very quickly drew a portrait that had witnesses exclaiming, “that looks just like him”.

sentences.simplified: 凶手看到门口与自己一模一样的画像，自知已走投无路，
sentences.traditional: 兇手看到門口與自己一模一樣的畫像，自知已走投無路，
sentences.pinyin: xiōng shǒu kàn dào mén kǒu yǔ zì jǐ yì mú yí yàng de huà xiàng zì zhī yǐ zǒu tóu wú lù
sentences.english: The portrait was posted all over the city, even in front of the murderer’s home.

sentences.simplified: 只能投案自首了。
sentences.traditional: 只能投案自首了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng tóu àn zì shǒu le
sentences.english: When the murderer saw a portrait that looked exactly like him in front of his home, he knew that he had no way out.
He could only turn himself in.

sentences.simplified: 除了痕检和画像，中国法医们也从古代文献中找到了很多检验灵感，
sentences.traditional: 除了痕檢和畫像，中國法醫們也從古代文獻中找到了很多檢驗靈感，
sentences.pinyin: chú le hén jiǎn hé huà xiàng zhōng guó fǎ yī men yě cóng gǔ dài wén xiàn zhōng zhǎo dào le hěn duō jiǎn yàn líng gǎn

sentences.simplified: 现代科技和古代经验相结合，在侦查破案过程中发挥了巨大的作用。
sentences.traditional: 現代科技和古代經驗相結合，在偵查破案過程中發揮了巨大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn dài kē jì hé gǔ dài jīng yàn xiāng jié hé zài zhēn chá pò àn guò chéng zhōng fā huī le jù dà de zuò yòng
sentences.english: Aside from trace examination and portraits, Chinese forensic investigators have found inspiration from ancient texts.

sentences.simplified: 其中宋代宋慈的《洗冤集录》
sentences.traditional: 其中宋代宋慈的《洗冤集錄》
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng sòng dài sòng cí de xǐ yuān jí lù
sentences.english: The combination of modern technology with ancient experience has played a huge role in the process of investigating and solving cases.

sentences.simplified: 就是每个法医都必看的法医学好书。
sentences.traditional: 就是每個法醫都必看的法醫學好書。
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì měi ge fǎ yī dōu bì kàn de fǎ yī xué hǎo shū
sentences.english: Among these is Song Ci’s “Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified” from the mid-Song dynasty.
This forensic science book is a must-read for forensic investigators.

sentences.simplified: 正是由于中国警察们的不懈努力，
sentences.traditional: 正是由於中國警察們的不懈努力，
sentences.pinyin: zhèng shì yóu yú zhōng guó jǐng chá men de bù xiè nǔ lì

sentences.simplified: 他们既学习国外先进的刑侦技术，
sentences.traditional: 他們既學習國外先進的刑偵技術，
sentences.pinyin: tā men jì xué xí guó wài xiān jìn de xíng zhēn jì shù
sentences.english: It is precisely because of the continuous hard work of the Chinese police, ..

sentences.simplified: 又汲取古代技术的经验，同时还结合中国的国情不断创新，
sentences.traditional: 又汲取古代技術的經驗，同時還結合中國的國情不斷創新，
sentences.pinyin: yòu jí qǔ gǔ dài jì shù de jīng yàn tóng shí hái jié hé zhōng guó de guó qíng bú duàn chuàng xīn
sentences.english: .. in studying advanced criminal investigation technology from abroad, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以近些年中国的破案率明显提高了。
sentences.traditional: 所以近些年中國的破案率明顯提高了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ jìn xiē nián zhōng guó de pò àn lǜ míng xiǎn tí gāo le
sentences.english: .. as well as drawing experience from ancient methods, combined with China’s constant innovation as a country, ..
.. that in recent years, China’s clear-up rate has improved significantly.

sentence_translations: Miraculous Feats of the Chinese Police
In Chinese history, there have been many particularly outstanding figures.
They used their exceptional analytical and other unique skills to crack countless bizarre and complicated cases.
For example, there is the “Tang Dynasty’s amazing detective Di Renjie”, ..
.. “The Song Dynasty’s leading forensic investigator Song Ci” …
Although they did not have the same precise and sophisticated technology in ancient times that we have today, ..
.. there were many intriguing and mystical examination techniques.
One example is Song Ci’s “bone-steaming examination” method.
The first step of the “bone-steaming inspection” method was to “steam the bones”.
This is to make the skeleton cleaner for ease of examination.
This is because if people are beaten when they were alive, ..
.. blood will permeate into the bones, and the bones will have bloodstains.
However, these bloodstains are very difficult to see with just the naked eye.
So, Song Ci thought of a second step: open a red oil-paper umbrella and use the red oil-paper umbrella to filter sunlight.
After sunlight is filtered through the paper umbrella, people can very clearly see the stains on the bones!
The use of UV light to examine bone injuries by modern forensic investigators still follows the same principle.
There were such great masters in ancient times.
Since then, what other “miraculous feats” have Chinese police achieved in solving crimes?
First, I’m going to introduce “catching the culprit from footprints”. This is “footprint examination”.
Through footprints, not only can a person’s height, weight, figure, walking posture, etc., be determined, ..
.. even sex and age can be confirmed using footprints.
For example, a horrendous serial murder case took place in China with 23 victims.
The criminal wore different shoes each time he committed a crime.
The police conducted thorough searches of over 4,000 suspects and recorded their footprints, both with shoes and barefoot.
But no one could confirm which pair of footprints matched the footprints left at the scene.
However, after footprint experts analyzed the footprints, they reached the following conclusions:
The suspect was around 38 years old, 168 cm tall, and overweight.
The police pursued the culprit on this basis, and within one week, they arrested the suspect.
There is also “finding the culprit with a portrait”.
A pen and a piece of paper, based on eyewitness descriptions, ..
.. can clearly and accurately portray the appearance of the suspect.
Additionally, as time elapses, time markers can be added to the portrait.
This leaves crime suspects nowhere to hide, no matter how much time passes.
For instance, an exceptionally large serial murder case in Lanzhou in Gansu brought sudden panic to Lanzhou residents.
Using witness descriptions, a forensic sketch artist very quickly drew a portrait that had witnesses exclaiming, “that looks just like him”.
The portrait was posted all over the city, even in front of the murderer’s home.
When the murderer saw a portrait that looked exactly like him in front of his home, he knew that he had no way out.
He could only turn himself in.
Aside from trace examination and portraits, Chinese forensic investigators have found inspiration from ancient texts.
The combination of modern technology with ancient experience has played a huge role in the process of investigating and solving cases.
Among these is Song Ci’s “Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified” from the mid-Song dynasty.
This forensic science book is a must-read for forensic investigators.
It is precisely because of the continuous hard work of the Chinese police, ..
.. in studying advanced criminal investigation technology from abroad, ..
.. as well as drawing experience from ancient methods, combined with China’s constant innovation as a country, ..
.. that in recent years, China’s clear-up rate has improved significantly.
